taskDescription: Match each bacterial STI organism's microscopic appearance (left) with its characteristic clinical presentation (right).

cards.imageAlt: Gram stain of urethral smear showing intracellular Gram-negative diplococci within neutrophils, characteristic of Neisseria gonorrhoeae
cards.matchAlt: Profuse purulent urethral discharge characteristic of gonococcal urethritis

cards.imageAlt: Dark-field microscopy showing bright corkscrew-shaped Treponema pallidum spirochaetes against a dark background
cards.matchAlt: Single painless indurated chancre with clean base and rolled margins, characteristic of primary syphilis

cards.imageAlt: Giemsa-stained endocervical cells showing intracytoplasmic basophilic inclusion bodies of Chlamydia trachomatis
cards.matchAlt: Mucopurulent endocervical discharge with contact bleeding characteristic of chlamydial cervicitis
